name: h-tosho
description: Metadata fetcher & manager for Kavita (AniList, MangaUpdates, MangaDex, MyAnimeList, Bangumi)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @h-tosho/server" "npm run dev --workspace @h-tosho/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @h-tosho/web && npm run build --workspace @h-tosho/server
